tools.name: task-list
tools.description: List tasks in actionable order (unblocked first, then by priority). Closed tasks are hidden unless include_closed is set.

parent.description: only children of this task slug

tools.name: task-get
tools.description: Full detail for one task: body, active blockers, subtasks, links, decisions, and recent journal — rendered as markdown and JSON.

tools.name: task-next
tools.description: The single highest-priority actionable task (pending/in_progress with no active blockers).

tools.name: task-tree
tools.description: The task forest, or the subtree under a given slug, nested with children.

slug.description: root task slug; omit for the whole forest

tools.name: task-create
tools.description: Create a task, optionally under a parent, with blocking dependencies.

blocked_by.description: slugs of tasks that block this one

slug.description: explicit slug; derived from the title when omitted

tools.name: task-update
tools.description: Update a task's fields. Setting status to done/dropped stamps its close time and unblocks dependents.

new_slug.description: rename the task's slug; normalized like a created slug, and must not collide with an existing task

parent.description: new parent slug; empty string detaches to top level

tools.name: task-add-blocker
tools.description: Add one or more blocking dependencies to an existing task — it stays blocked until each blocker is done or dropped.

blocked_by.description: slugs of tasks that block this one

tools.name: task-remove-blocker
tools.description: Remove one or more blocking dependencies from a task. Both the task and each named blocker must exist; an edge that isn't set is a no-op.

blocked_by.description: slugs of blocking tasks to detach

tools.name: task-toc
tools.description: List the ## section paths within a task's body.

tools.name: task-section-get
tools.description: Read one section of a task body by heading path (e.g. "Design/Storage").

tools.name: task-section-set
tools.description: Replace one section of a task body, leaving the rest untouched.

tools.name: task-section-append
tools.description: Append a block to the end of a task-body section (after its subsections).

tools.name: task-section-insert
tools.description: Insert a new section into a task body relative to an existing heading path (omit path to target the document).

path.description: existing heading path; omit or empty to target the document

position.description: where to insert relative to path

tools.name: task-section-delete
tools.description: Delete a task-body section and its subsections.

tools.name: task-section-move
tools.description: Move a task-body section (with its subsections) before or after another heading path.

after.description: move it immediately after this heading path

before.description: move it immediately before this heading path

tools.name: task-body-replace
tools.description: Replace an exact, unique substring in a task body (empty replacement removes it); errors if the text is absent or appears more than once.

new.description: replacement text (default empty, which removes it)

tools.name: task-link
tools.description: Attach an external link to a task — a GitHub issue/PR by full URL, a commit, a file, or any URL. Kind is auto-detected from the URL.

tools.name: task-decide
tools.description: Record a decision made while executing a task — what was chosen and why. Kept as a queryable record and shown under the task's Decisions section.

tools.name: task-journal
tools.description: Append a freeform note to the running log, optionally against a task.

slug.description: task slug; omit for a project-level note

tools.name: record-edit
tools.description: Correct a decision or journal entry in place: replace one markdown field of an existing record by id. Does not append a journal correction.

field.description: field to replace: "decision" or "rationale" for a decision, "text" for a journal entry

tools.name: record-delete
tools.description: Delete a decision or journal entry by id.

tools.name: work-find
tools.description: Search tasks, decisions, and the journal — for finding what was done and decided, not just what's open.

has_decisions.description: only tasks that carry a decision

query.description: free text matched against titles, bodies, decisions, journal, and link URLs

since.description: RFC3339 lower bound on decision/journal timestamps

status.description: restrict matched tasks to this status

tools.name: session-summary
tools.description: Close the current session with a summary of what it accomplished, for the next session to read.
